text:
Nina: Quick sync  we need a one-pager battlecard for SDRs focused on launch next week. Keep it skimmable.

Eli: Draft structure: 3 hero claims, 3 one-line rebuttals, 2 bench narrative bullets, and a tiny demo snippet.

Rhea: Hero claim ideas: 'Serve where you need it', 'Predictable unit economics', 'Built for production rollouts'.

Sam: Tone: short, concrete, avoid raw numbers in headline. Use 'typical outcomes' instead.

Nina: Inbound routing note: tag leads as demo | dedicated-interest | eval. dedicated-interest -> SDR+SE.

Eli: Objection handlers (30s):
- 'We use cloud endpoints' -> 'Keep your existing endpoints but get one runtime, unified metrics, and predictable cost controls.'
- 'Don’t want to manage infra' -> 'We offer hosted and private modes so you pick the right tradeoff.'

Rhea: Bench narratives (short):
- Chat-first SaaS: steady-rate tokens, benefits from batching + KV cache -> lower per-token tail cost and stable p95.
- Bursty ingestion: variable seq length, benefits from routing + canary rollback to keep availability.

Sam: Quick demo snippet for playbook:
```
# pseudo fallback
if reserved_pool.available < threshold:
  route(req, variant='hosted-fallback')
else:
  route(req, variant='reserved')
```

ops-bot: Landing page created -> /events/serve-smart.

Nina: Timeline: one-pager by EOD tomorrow, SDR cheat-sheet by Wed, Intercom rules live by Thu. I'll compile and post in #marketing-drafts.

Eli: I'll take hero copy + bench bullets.

Rhea: I'll do the rebuttals and the demo GIFs.

Sam: I'll wire Intercom tags and automation. Will share screenshots once done.

Nina: Thanks team  short and sharp. :rocket:
